statements.proposition: All of the project's tests (`pnpm test`) pass at the head commit of this change.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Environment built as CI does (pnpm 10.14.0, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeded, vitest 3.2.4), but `pnpm test` / `vitest run` under the required sandbox stops right after '[vpw:info] Starting isolated runtimes for vitest.config.ts...' with ELIFECYCLE and no test results. The tests run in the Cloudflare workers pool (workerd), which evidently cannot start inside the network-denied sandbox, and network use is allowed only for installs. This is a limit of the reader's environment, not evidence of failing tests. No CI runs are recorded for the head commit.
evidence: PR file list includes added tests/storage/s3-storage.test.ts and modified tests/storage/storage-manager.test.ts; package.json test script is `vitest run --coverage`; ci.yml runs pnpm install, lint, typecheck, test, build
sbx.py: pnpm test and `pnpm exec vitest run tests/storage/s3-storage.test.ts`: output ends at the 'Starting isolated runtimes' line, no tests reported (pnpm: ELIFECYCLE Test failed)
workerd binary itself runs in the sandbox (`workerd --version` prints workerd 2025-08-13), so the failure is in the vitest pool startup
gh api check-runs and actions runs for head SHA bf699cff: no results
